comments.name: Sofia Camilleri
comments.text: Went to Noni last month — absolutely stunning. The tasting menu was worth every cent. Thanks for the recommendation, Tiago!

comments.name: Marco Borg
comments.text: Tal-Petut is a gem! I asked locals where to eat real Maltese food and they all pointed me there. The rabbit stew was incredible. Saved this post for my next visit.

comments.name: Lena Fischer
comments.text: De Mondion has an unbeatable view over the Grand Harbour. Perfect for a special dinner. Would love a post on budget eating in Valletta too!
